::: {#exm-feedforward-network}

#### An MLP for the digits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
_ = torch.manual_seed(1)
mlp = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(64, 32),
    nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(32, 10),
)
print(mlp)
scores = mlp(x_test[:5])
print(scores.shape)
```

`nn.Sequential` applies its layers in order,
so `mlp` is a [feedforward network](#def-feedforward-network) with one [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer) of [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width) 32,
the [ReLU](#def-relu) as its [activation function](#def-activation-function),
and 10 outputs, one per digit.
For 5 test images it returns a [tensor](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-tensor) of [shape](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-shape) (5, 10):
10 numbers for each image.

:::
